description: A second process is started while the first is still running
A stop marks the connection stopped without waiting for the process
old:
conn' = "closing" /\ stdinOpen' = FALSE /\ armed' = armed \cup {<<"grace", gen>>}
         [] conn \in Down ->
new:
conn' = "stopped" /\ stdinOpen' = FALSE /\ armed' = armed
         [] conn \in Down ->

description: A line from an earlier process is delivered after a restart
Messages are still written after stdin was closed for shutdown
Planted bug, must be caught: server requests are answered in every era, including 2026
A stop sends SIGTERM without closing stdin first
old:
conn' = "closing" /\ stdinOpen' = FALSE /\ armed' = armed \cup {<<"grace", gen>>}
         [] conn \in Down ->
new:
conn' = "closing" /\ stdinOpen' = TRUE /\ armed' = armed \cup {<<"grace", gen>>}
         [] conn \in Down ->

description: A grace timer from an earlier process cuts the current one's grace period short
old:
/\ <<"grace", g>> \in armed
    /\ IF g = gen /\ conn = "closing"

description: One failure too many is allowed before the connection is marked failed
A backoff timer from an earlier failure ends the current backoff early
SIGTERM is never followed by SIGKILL
old:
THEN conn' = "killing" /\ sent' = sent \cup {"kill"}
          ELSE UNCHANGED <<conn, sent>>
new:
THEN UNCHANGED <<conn, sent>>
          ELSE UNCHANGED <<conn, sent>>

description: A process that exits during a stop leaves the connection idle instead of stopped
old:
/\ IF stopping
          THEN conn' = "stopped" /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, armed>>
          ELSE Failure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, era, stopping, errored, sent, pipe,
new:
/\ IF stopping
          THEN conn' = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED <<attempts, armed>>
          ELSE Failure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, era, stopping, errored, sent, pipe,
